title: Little Gem Salad with Lemon-Dijon Vinaigrette
short: Crisp lettuce wedges, a bright shallot dressing and toasted nuts.
keywords: Little Gem Salad with Lemon-Dijon Vinaigrette, date night, dinner for two, classic, fancy
intro: Every rich dinner needs something crisp and sharp beside it. Little gem lettuce cut into wedges holds dressing between its leaves, and a shallot-lemon vinaigrette wakes everything up.
why: It balances rich mains and shows you think about the whole plate, not just the centerpiece.

ings.i: heads little gem lettuce (or 1 romaine heart)

ings.h: 15 g (½ oz)

steps.t: Soak the shallot in the lemon juice with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes to soften its bite.
Whisk in the Dijon and honey, then the oil. Season.
Cut the lettuces lengthwise into quarters, keeping the core so they hold together.
Arrange cut side up, spoon the dressing between the leaves and top with nuts, Parmesan, herbs and pepper.

tips: Dress at the last minute so the leaves stay crisp.
makeahead: Make the dressing up to 3 days ahead.
plating: A long platter with the wedges laid in a row looks better than a heaped bowl.

faq.a: Use maple syrup instead of honey and skip the Parmesan.
